shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
help.wiring: Only horizontal and vertical segments; wires leave a pin at right angles to the block edge. Crossing wires are not connected — a filled dot is a shared junction.
help.editing: Drag from a pin to another pin to connect them. Drag blocks to move them, or box-select and move them together; arrow keys nudge, Shift + arrow moves further. Every change can be undone.
help.views: A block diagram has a function view and a power view (Shift+V); switching changes the drawing only, not the data.
help.organize: Organize lists a few layouts with before / after previews and metrics; applying one is a single undo step. It is heuristic and does not guarantee the fewest crossings.
help.disclaimer: Voltages and currents are manual annotations; the power view only sums downstream demand. Nothing is simulated, and part or cable ratings are not checked. Equal labels are not connected.
help.palette: Press {keys} for the command palette: search commands, switch designs or go to a block / task.
